features.note: Ceiling-mounted mini-dome, flat base up, smoked bubble below. Envelope 0.1010 x 0.0560 x 0.1010 m exact to spec after seven build passes. Zero mass drift — unlike the rack-eared siblings, nothing on this device exceeds its own envelope.
Interior legible through the smoked bubble; ?dome=off proves it exists. Pose-visibility matrix (view x dome x tilt = 12 states) reports 100% reachable front-element surface in every state.

Articulated: at tilt=22 the lens tilts off-axis (hero), at tilt=0 it points straight down and reads clearly — the lens reads ACROSS poses, the gap this pass closed (all prior framing ran the DEFAULT tilt; a lens legible at 22 and gone at 45 would have shipped). Trunnions supported in the yoke.
Matte black cone reads as a cavity (smoked bubble no longer washes it to a luminaire). No metalness shortcut.
Trim ring larger than the bubble; AXIS wordmark upright; smooth silhouette at dpr4.

important_features.note: Green LED reads as ON (brighter than its bezel through ACES); intensity at the recorded ceiling.
Ceiling prop toggles, excluded from the cylinder-measured envelope.

defects: OPEN ITEMS (all documented AND verified still-documented, none a defect): MODEL unknown/unknowable — AC:CC:8E is an Axis OUI (manufacturer only, not model or category); every dimension is the M3085-V's used as a declared surrogate; a site photo is the highest-value evidence anyone could add. SCREWS not built (P1 has no count/type/position; the check walks the graph for any screw/bolt/fastener mesh and finds none). BUBBLE TINT smoked is measured-as-necessary (a near-white bubble washed the black cavity to 76% of the collar), not documented. LED colour green is convention. WORDMARK position chosen to fit, not measured.
framing-probe overlapsHUD is a bbox-vs-silhouette false positive on this round subject (resolved by pixel measurement in the lighting-camera review).
corrections: None for the standalone asset. Scene/library: carry the transparency pick(), the cylinder-containment guard, verifyPartsAreOnTheDevice-equivalents, the sagitta tessellation solver, and the boot check into any reuse.

mechanical.notes: 13/13 suites (trace, struct, framing, light, materials, surface, orient, tonemap, interaction, optimization, boot, float, p6). Console clean across default, dome=off, under, tilt=0 (captured --page, dpr3). Envelope exact. CONTAINMENT MEASURED AS A CYLINDER (radial): max radius 50.50 mm vs 50.5 mm envelope, y span [-56.00, 0.00] vs declared — a box around a disc leaves the corners free where a piece could sneak in. 5/5 criticals with complete geometry, 9 materials 0 drift all rendered, 4/4 UI controls with BOTH a DOM button and a URL state. Budget 15/120 draws, 8048/250000 tris (3.2%), 13 unique geometries cache-covered, faceting < 0.5 px at dpr4, offline clean, boot clean. THE POSE-VISIBILITY GAP: prior framing ran only the default tilt; this pass measures the reachable front-element fraction across all 12 view x dome x tilt states (all 100%, LED 81%) AND DISTRUSTS THE FLAT RESULT — 12 states at exactly 100% could mean healthy-everywhere or blind-to-pose, so it was made to fail on purpose (an 80deg out-of-range tilt into the shroud wall -> 85%; an opaque plate 4 mm in front -> 15%), proving the plateau is a real result, not a metric that cannot fail.

notes: FINAL gate — inline orchestrator judgment. The axis-camera asset is COMPLETE. It was the run's hardest — the only new geometric class (a translucent dome) carrying problems none of the boxes had: transparency without transmission, veil-vs-hole occlusion, a downward-facing subject the house rig lit from the wrong side, and an articulated mechanism whose poses a default-tilt check would never see. Every one landed, and along the way it produced the run's richest crop of new instruments: transparency-aware picking (eye and click reachability must coincide), judging THROUGH the ACES tone curve, the sagitta turning faceting into a pixel count (and revealing the counter-intuitive raise-tessellation answer), cylinder containment, and a pose-visibility matrix that distrusts its own flat result. The integrity discipline is impeccable and even surfaced in the PROCEDENCIA HUD: a model that cannot be known from an OUI is declared generic, dimensions are a labelled surrogate, no model number/ratings/screws are fabricated, and five honest open items are held rather than invented. Cleared. Remaining run work: FMPS and the scene assembly.
